Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages

Class DevPageBuilders

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.pages.DevPageBuilders
public final class DevPageBuilders extends Object
Builder twins of the Developer pages: Custom cards (cards.ftlh), Rendering flavors (flavors.ftlh, flavors-react.ftlh), Secure (secure.ftlh), Themes (themes.ftlh), Charts (builder only), Data sources (builder only) and Dashboard (builder only).
Example:

return twin(req, DevPageBuilders.secure());

    • cards

      public static PageSpec cards()
      Custom cards.

      The gauge card's body is the same {species, low, high} the FTL page authors: PageSpec runs it through the registered InventoryGaugeCardType, so both pages carry the same validated fragment.

      The page spec.

    • themes

      public static PageSpec themes(String theme, boolean custom, List<String> choices)
      Themes.

      The theme itself is drawn by the chrome (base.ftlh), so the spec carries the same petstoreTheme / petstoreCustomTheme attributes the FTL page does.

      Parameters:
      theme - The stock theme to draw in (the custom theme's seed when custom).
      custom - Whether the custom tokens are applied.
      choices - The theme names to offer.
      Returns:
      The page spec.
